HOST_SUBTITLE: Where the files you attach go. Their links are put in your message instead.
UPLOAD_WHEN_AUTO_SUBTITLE: Files bigger than Discord lets you send in that channel; the rest attach to Discord
UPLOAD_WHEN_SIZE_SUBTITLE: Files bigger than the size below; the rest attach to Discord
CATBOX_SUBTITLE: catbox.moe, kept until removed, up to 200 MB
LITTERBOX_SUBTITLE: Catbox's temporary host, up to 1 GB
CUSTOM_SUBTITLE: Your own server or another host that takes form uploads
CUSTOM_URL_SUBTITLE: Files are sent here as a multipart form POST.
CUSTOM_FILE_FIELD_SUBTITLE: The form field the file goes in.
CUSTOM_HEADERS_SUBTITLE: One per line, like Authorization: Bearer your-token.
RESPONSE_TEXT_SUBTITLE: The whole answer is the link.
RESPONSE_JSON_SUBTITLE: The link is at a path in the JSON answer.
UPLOAD_FAILED: The upload failed, so the files are attached to Discord as usual.
NO_HOST: Set an upload address for your custom host in the plugin's settings.
